balls.text: offcutter outside off, slapped into the covers for a single
presents a full toss outside leg stump - because Ashwin had feigned to make room - tickled away to the long leg boundary. Good work from the batsman

shortish on leg stump, Ashwin has managed to make great connection. Simple little flick beats square leg and gives Russell a lot of work. Races in from deep midwicket, slides to pull the ball back, but his boot was touching the rope
saw the batman charging, or did he read the nervousness in him? Slower, fuller and wider. Faf can only get a bottom edge to long-off
the offcutter again and Faf runs outside off for a scoop. Can't connect and somehow the ball manages to bounce over the stumps

struck in the gut! He's winded, goes down on his haunches. Can't respond to his partner's call for a single. It's the offcutter, bowled short. Sticks in the pitch and foil's Faf's timing on the pull. "Ooof," Faf yells but he's okay
finishes with a dot - his ninth of the night - and it's a googly that Ashwin can't pick. Pokes after it having read it from the pitch and is easily beaten. 4-0-18-1

he deserves that! Slid in the quicker, flatter delivery as he saw Jaddu running at him. No room to work the ball. All he can do is try and stop it from passing him. But since he wanted to belt the ball, he's in two minds. Uncertain prod does him in
runs down the track, gets to the pitch of what would have been a length ball, and drums it to long-on. KKR fielders everywhere
wrong 'un beats Faf! He was making room, and ends up having too much as he goes for a wild slog. Beaten
fuller and flatter on off stump, Jaddu camps back and cuts behind point

Faf showed his ace too early. Leapt outside leg and allowed Hoggy to adjust his plan. Flat and outside off stump to make sure he can only reach with the bottom of the bat. Gee, he's read the batsmen so well
that time he was set up for the slower ball, back leg outside off, front leg cleared away and slugged to long-on
another slower bouncer, but it's ballooned over the batsman. Faf lets it go and collects the 12th extra of the innings
beats him on the slower short ball. Faf too early on the pull and he misses out. Lovely adaptation from the big, tall Aussie quick
goes a shade too wide with his wide yorker
full and wide this time, Jaddu was halfway through clearing his front leg when he has to throw his arms out and manage an outside edge to third man
third slower ball on the trot and they've all been short. Faf drags a pull to deep midwicket
another off pace delivery and Jaddu makes room to flay it through the covers. Protection there as well. Knight Riders are pulling off the squeeze perfectly
slower, but shortish on off stump, Jaddu goes back to cut and finds point
quick, flat, no room. Jaddu's pull is mistimed and ends up at long-on
flighted on off, Faf plays with the turn and slog sweeps to square leg
goes short and flat, Jaddu pulls to deep midwicket again where Russell, their best fielder, is wating
shortish and outside off, tapped towards point

that's precision mark! He's done this a few times before. Picking a gap that is so narrow it seems he's got a computer in his head to find the angles. Gets forward and swipes a really full delivery between a diving deep midwicket and long-on
drags it short and Jaddu has nailed a pull to deep midwicket. Can't beat the man though
yep, and Jaddu's lifted it one bounce short of an onrushing long-on
another pacy back of a length delivery on middle and leg. Jaddu gets an inside edge onto the hip. Faf isn't interested in the single
top edge! But this time Yusuf's quick enough to manage the save. Goes for a last minute dive to keep the mistimed pull to only two

145kph, hit him in the helmet! Russell's short ball has been having a ball today with a slightly two paced pitch. Into the pull a touch too late and there'll be a ringing in his ears to remind him not to do that
this one's quick - 142 kph - Faf goes for a short-armed pull but only manages an inside edge onto the hip and to deep third man
slower ball way outside off and dribbles away to the keeper. Your usual Chepauk slow roller
shortish and outside off, Faf gets inside the line and clips it to deep square leg. Another two brings up the CSK 100
bounces up a little more than Jaddu expects - he'll like that when he and Ashwin bowl - dabs towards point
they've stolen two! Jaddu's barely dabbed it into the leg side, Midwicket has spotted the urgency and Pandey raced in. Goes for an underarm throw. But can't beat the two batsmen
short and a shade wide, Faf was looking to belt it over midwicket. But it appears to come a little slower off the pitch. Mis-hit to long-on
he's preferred to play off the back foot all day, and now he's getting the lengths to justify that premeditation. Cut away to sweeper cover
seems to get a touch more bounce, Jaddu adjusts though and tucks it behind square leg
goes back and slaps a short ball to deep point. Neat footwork
good length on off stump, kept out and Knight Riders will enjoy a pretty chilled out time out
stands up tall behind a shortish delivery outside off and punches it through the covers
stays rooted to his crease and pushes a length delivery, with some room outside off, down to long-off
140kph, too quick for Jaddu. It's short and outside off, he goes for a slice behind point. Can't connect
that's timed quite well. Short ball at 142 kph, but doesn't quite rise all that high. Pulled to deep midwicket
back of a length and outside off, left well enough alone

too easy! Reward for baiting the batsman with flight. He threw this one up and wide. Duped the batsman into thinking it was overpitched. Bravo wanted extra cover again. But ends up giving a dolly to long-off
flighted outside off, pushed towards point
teases him with a lot of flight and a lot of width too. But somehow Bravo misses out on the big slap over cover. Uthappa appeals for a stumping, but nothing amounts from it
goes back to a flatter ball and slices it to point. Easy single
wide of the crease and Bravo stretches out to dab into the covers. Little look up to see if Faf was up for a quick single. He is. Great work from the two batsmen
flighted delivery on leg stump, Faf looks to stay beside it and push to mid-off. Has to accept an inside edge to square leg
and that's why. Vicious hit over extra cover. Overpitched from Russell and Bravo holds nothing back as he presses forward and swings free
back of a length on off stump, defended stoutly
lovely welcome to countryman Bravo! Nails another bouncer and has the batsman ducking for cover. Pacy too

that's the bouncer and he's got him! He's not been good on the short ball. Not when they're fast and rising above his ribs. Dhoni got inside the line to hammer it away past long leg. But only ends up with a feather to the keeper. Big wicket, and Russell celebrates it as such
short and down leg again - Russell's been off with his lines today - pulled to long leg
shortish on off stump, Dhoni covers the stumps and deftly nudges it behind square leg. Lovely late connection, and a swirl of the wrists
orthodox leggie this time that Dhoni guides to point and sets off
that's the googly, but it's short and Faf had set up for the pull. With the ball coming in though he doesn't quite have the room. Mis-hits to long-on
goes wide of the crease a touch and flights it on off stump. Faf prefers to stay back and block
flatter delivery, which turns outside off. But Dhoni prefers to whip it through to deep square leg
nudged through midwicket again as Chawla bowls slow and gives the ball a lot of air
loopy delivery that's eased to deep midwicket. Tendo races in, looks for a one-handed pick up and throw. But he's misfleded. Took his eyes off too early
shortish on off stump, knocked into the leg side

poor all around from Knight Riders. Horrible lapse in line from Russell sends the ball way down leg. The keeper can't collect it either and the fielders take too long to gather around it. So Dhoni turns nothing into two runs
works the ball past Gambhir at midwicket. Shuffles across to the off side to work the ball away
short and wandering away down leg. Second wide of the over
shortish and at Dhoni's stomach. The batsman gets off his feet and runs it to long leg. Not altogether comfortably

soft dismissal. Shortish and outside off, the typical ball every batsman wants to run down to third man. Only this time there seems a bit more zip on it and Raina edges it behind, Cross-seamer it would seem
banged in short, a little too much so. Raina's neck must hurt as he cranes it up to follow the ball's path to the keeper's gloves
shortish and outside off, pulled towards mid-on actually. Half-hearted shot as he is wary of the ball not coming on as he thought it would
back of a length and outside off, Faf glides it to deep third man.
leans forward and taps a flighted delivery through to deep midwicket. Hoggy is after it for a while, but gives up the chase
tosses it up on off stump, Faf shuffles across and blocks it under his eyes

this has been a great little mini-battle. Raina looks to get a leg up by racing down the pitch, but Hoggy's pulled his length back and the Chennai pitch helps him out with some turn and bounce. Raina follows it with his hands and gets an outside edge. Wants a single to escape the stranglehold and that's ended up a mistake as well. Smith is well short. Yusuf with the direct throw from short third man.
goes flatter to Smith and gives him the single he seems to prefer lately. Nudged to square leg. Raina v Hoggy again, this is good
gorgeous flight from Hoggy, and he lures a false stroke. Raina lunges forward and looks to loft him. Only gets a leading edge between point and cover. Uppish, but safe.
goes back to try and read the turn off the pitch and plays with it as the ball comes in. Clipped through square leg

that's his strength. If the ball is full, and it's tagged with some width, Raina is one of the most cleanest strikers. Plants that front leg and lifts it over extra cover like a boss. Apologies to MS. Oh, and it's a time out. Go sit in a corner and lets all catch our breath
flash and miss again. Raina shakes his head as he practices the upper cut after it fails
goes for the slice behind point again, but this time Russell's put a little more effort in the ball. 136 kph lifter beats him outside off
stays back to a slightly short, slightly wide delivery and slaps it to point. Just a little later and he could have had the gap he wanted. Good thinking
full on off stump, Smith knocks it down to long-on and gets off strike
presses forward and taps a good length but wide delivery into the covers. Gambhir is there, but he lets the ball go through him. Iffy work
reaches out on the front foot and slides it to short fine leg
rocks back to try and force the ball to midwicket, but the ball skids in and cramps his bat swing
good length on the stumps, Raina looks to turn it into the leg side. Doesn't succeed. Little leading edge back at the bowler
that's the googly, but it's been picked and Raina guides it to short fine leg
no slip, and Raina gets a thick outside edge to short third man. Turn for Hoggy as he lands it on a good length and drags the batsman to poke outside off
pushes it through on off stump, Smith goes back and just about connects the flick on time. Work for deep midwicket
144kph, full on off stump, Raina stays back against the extra pace and looks for a flick. Doesn't get it right as the ball goes down the pitch
147kph, gets across to a fuller ball outside off, blocks it down to mid-off
poor ball, dealt with without remorse. Raina leaps off his feet to get on top of a short and wide delivery and lashes it to the point boundary
good length and outside off, Raina slides it to point
shortish on leg stump, Raina gets a little inside the line of it to tickle it fine. Doesn't get bat
still not quite picking up the pace of the ball. Hits high on the splice as he looks to pull a 141 kph short ball on the body. Loops up somewhere around square leg
so he prefers the other go-to shot for a left-hander with the ball spinning in. Down on one knee and a powerful slog sweep over square leg
down the track straight away, but Chawla pulls his length back. Dabbed to square leg

wrong 'un does him in! Drew him forward with the length and then the pitch offers just enough turn, at just enough pace to beat Baz. Defends down the wrong line, struck in front. Oh, but was there an inside edge? McCullum's reaction suggests as much...
this time stands rooted to his crease and swings. Ugly shot. Easily beaten

he was nowhere in position! But stretched his hands out just enough to meet the ball and bash it over the bowler. Came down the track, Chawla beat him with a wide, tossed up delivery. But this format is quite cruel on a bowler. More of a bottom edge
flighted on off stump, eased to the left of mid-off
edged... but doesn't carry to slip! All of his boundaries so far are from behind the pitch. A tempting fuller ball outside off, Smith throws his bat, gets another fortunate edge
this was a poor ball. Went for the extra pace, loses his radar down leg and it's helped ot the long leg boundary

how about that, it's a top edge. Cruel outcome for the bowler as he pulls a bit of pace off the ball. He already had the batsman nervous. Had him wanting to put bat to ball. Smith was eager on the pull, realised midway through the shot he was years too early. But escapes anyway as it sails away over third man
full and targeted at off stump, kept out gingerly
a little fuller this time, and some appreciable inswing. Smith doesn't like it when he doesn't have room. Plays an awful across the line flick and misses. Weathers a lbw appeal
skids off the deck and pings Smith on the pads. Uncomfortable hit as he goes down on his haunches to gather himself. Just back of a length and it beat Smith's flick
goes short, slides down leg. Easy call for the batsman to just collect the extra

looks for a yorker, almost finds it. But Baz has gotten an inch or so outside the line and clipped it handsomely behind square leg. Hoggy's the man after it, throws himself at the ball even after it's passed him, a la McCullum himself, but he's not really quick enough
jumps back in his crease to knock a back of a length delivery towards mid-on and set off
hopes to limit his room and slides a fuller ball on the pads. Glances off it towards square leg

races down. picks up a length ball and mauls it over the bowler's head. Not the best view for a fast bowler. And he's one of the fastest around. Made room, made great connection and just chews his gum and watches it sail away
clears that front leg, but Cummins is pacy and he's accurate as well. Restricts the width on offer and manages only an inside edge
145kph, fullish on middle, Baz brings down a sedate straight bat. An alert mid-on keeps the batsmen at their ends
a touch overpitched, Baz stands and drills to long-off. Russell's quick across the turf
races down the pitch to a 146 kph delivery, but he yorks himself and doesn't really have the room to free his arms as Umesh spears the ball in at his toes
147kph, swivels on the back foot and guides a shortish delivery through square leg. Didn't get the timing he wanted on the pull
cramps him with a shortish ball on the pads, McCullum looks to dab it behind square leg. Grazes his thigh pad and Uthappa fetches it back
just short of a good length on off stump, defended
he's guided it towards the third man boundary! Yusuf's lurking there, but he seems a little too sluggish. Had only a few metres to move to his left. Bounces in front of him and dribbles away

goes inswinger this time, belts out a lbw appeal as Smith appears late on the flick and is struck on the front pad. He's falling over as he plays the shot, but this fuller ball was angled a little too far down leg
back of a length on off stump, kept out
great pace from Cummins. Just enough cut away from the batsman. And tempting bounce. Smith is late on the shot and the ball shaves past the sticker

ohhhh, that wide slip almost came into play! Pandey leaps to his left but Smith has flashed hard at the shortish delivery outside off and gets a thick enough edge to sail away to the third man boundary
manages a fuller delivery to straighten at 144 kph. Hits a good spot in the deck and bounces higher than Smith expects. Defends, with one hand off the bat
back of a length and outside off, doesn't bother Smith into a shot
goes away to the boundary, but that's fine for CSK. They've defended 134! Gets down the track and drills a wide, fuller deliver past long-off
threads the gap at cover! Normal pace delivery and Tendo runs at it. Nearly yorks himself, but manages to squeeze it away
length ball, off pace, Tendo has stood and slammed it over midwicket. Big six. Timely six. But he's still under pressure
down the track and swings, an awful swing. Misses
full and wide outside off, Tendo goes for a slog and can't connect. Change of pace works again
slower ball, pushed wider outside off as Tendo moved across. Cut away to deep point...  doesn't take the single
length ball a shade outside off, Hoggy has slapped it past a diving extra cover and he's placed it wide of the sweeper as well. Perfect result for KKR
tail ender in sight, bowl full and straight, he misses, you hit. Nehra's made up for those two big hits earlier in the over

low full toss on off stump, Tendo slaps it down to long-on. "two," calls Tendo, but Umesh wasn't quick enough. The throw comes in quick, but its wayward. Dhoni misses it, the first back up misses it, but the second takes it. Which foils Tendo seeking an overthrow
he has nailed that! The last one was hit a little high on the bat but this one was perfectly off the middle. Front foot forward, full swing of the arms and the slog soars away over midwicket
finds the middle off a full toss and hammers it over cow corner. Smith was the man there, racing to his left. Couldn't make it by three or four yards
flings down a yorker that follows Tendo as he looks to make room. Tries to pull out of the shot since the ball was down leg, but then he is hit on the pads
skips down the track, but only gets an inside edge to the length ball that skews away behind square leg
standing outside the crease, races down the pitch and miscues the ball straight up. Dhoni rushes up, calls for it and takes a skier. And is promptly bear-hugged by Bravo
fuller ball slid across with the angle. Chawla's rooted to the crease against the offcutter and flays at it. No dice
offcutter on middle and leg, Tendo can only nudge the ball besides the pitch. Quick single taken
back of a length and outside off, nudged through square leg
picks out deep midwicket! Seems a slower ball and he's slogged it down Jadeja's throat
a shade back of a length on middle and leg, the batsman was looking to flick. Doesn't connect and weathers a leg before appeal. Possibly pitched outside leg.

short ball on middle, Tendo pulls to deep square leg. But Russell wants two! Oh dear, this could be bad! It is! Tendo says no from the non-strikers' end rightly perhaps, by which time Russell had been halfway down. He ran the first too slow, while Tendo was motoring. Has to turn, does his best, stretches as much as he could, but Jaddu's throw has beaten him. Another big wicket comes off a run-out for CSK
shortish, but not quite enough room even after Russell made room. Slapped to extra cover for a single
full on off stump, Tendo huffs and puffs for a mistimed swipe that skews to long-off
full on leg stump, Russell's cautious for now. Pushed to long-on
just short of a good length on middle, tucked to midwicket
slower ball with width, slid to point. He's not quite got the measure of a slow pitch. 7 off 12
slower ball, outside off, Russell slides it to point and races away to the other end
back of a length and following Tendo, who was moving outside leg, clipped to square leg
full on leg stump, orthodox straight bat to start and finds a single to long-on
slower ball does the trick and Bravo's off on a jig. It's a bit short so Yusuf loaded up on the pull, but he is a bit overeager. Manages an inside edge that disturbs the stumps
slower ball, right up there on middle and leg, nudged away but only as far as Dhoni who moves to his left and dives
shortish and outside off, Yusuf has waited on it nicely and cracked a cut to the left of the sweeper
fuller, slower ball outside off, Tendo pushes with soft hands and picks up a single in the covers
back of a length on middle, Tendo wanted to flick it through midwicket. Slowish deck doesn't allow it as the ball goes back to the bowler
lovely slower ball on middle, Yusuf waits on it and nudges into the vacant area at square leg

shortish and outside off, Tendo looks for a slap behind point. Baz is over there, grabs the ball and sends in a quick throw. The batsman has to dive back in. Makes his ground, and picks up a single off the ricochet. One stump to hit and he did it
back of a length skidder on and around off stump, Yusuf wanted to play it late but it rushes on him. Ball strikes the bat more than the other way around. Single to third man.
good length ball, slower too on off stump, pushed to long-on
flat, short and way too far down the leg side. Yusuf looks for a pull to long leg. No luck. Extra given
eased into the off side for a quick single
runs down the track and whips it to short midwicket. Struck hard enough that Baz drops it
pushed through on middle and leg, Tendo is beaten for the spin a touch as he looks to play a flick outside the line. Struck on the pads, but was sliding down
tossed up outside off, Yusuf swings mightily at it. Gets only a bottom edge to long-off
a yellow blur at point and when it comes up clutched with the ball in hand, its.... Baz. Shortish delivery neatly slid behind square. But for no runs
length ball with some width, camps on the back foot to punch to deep cover
shortish on off stump, he dabs it through point. Right through him, actually as Raina misfields.
worked away to deep square leg
goes a touch too short and Yusuf leaves it all alone and gets an extra

too quick for him and Bravo has pulled off a stunner running in from long-on! Chepaulk blows its lid! Goes on the pull, but this skids off the deck and gets on him far too early. Gets it on the splice. Bravo raced in. So did the man from Faf from long-off. Both men dived, but Bravo managed not to be distracted and pulls off a brilliant, low catch. Sparks wild celebrations
back of a length and a bit outside off, Yadav goes for a wild hoick and misses. He's 16 off 25...
whirl of the wrists accompanies a push to long-on
flighted on middle, turned to midwicket
shortish and a shade outside off, Yusuf pulls of a neat little late cut and takes on Ashish Nehra at short third man, who misfields
flatter ball in the face of Yusuf's big-hitting threat. Nudged to short midwicket
gives it a lot of air, Yadav drives to long-off

a shade short and wide, Yadav slaps it into the covers. Ashwin's the man close in as he tries to take a low catch to his left. Only gets a finger tip to it, and it's bleeding. It's his spinning hand as well. He's going off the field
swept off the stumps and finds a single to deep square leg
nudged towards square leg, qiuck and flat
good length ball on off stump, defended into the covers and Baz swoops on it again. Meanwhile, Hussey's at the boundary geeing up the crowd
held the ball back a touch, Pandey leans forward for a push into the covers. Baz does not allow the single
looks for long-on, but Jaddu hustles behind the non-striker, dives and gets a good hand to the ball
flighted outside off, pushed into the covers
tossed up a bit outside off, whipped to long-on
flighted outside off, drilled to long-off
good length ball a shade outside off, Yusuf goes for a little dab. Beaten
tapped towards long-on. Baz flies after it from midwicket, but can't grab it
misses a full toss. Low one as he goes for a booming drive through the off side
quite a full delivery but Yadav stays back and slices the ball towards third man
flighted outside off, drives smartly to long-off and that's the time out
shortish and outside off, cut away to deep point
flighted on the stumps, keeps it out
fired in on the stumps, Yusuf doesn't bother with his feet but blocks
flatter delivery on middle, whipped to long leg
flighted on off stump, defended into the off side
sweeps a tossed up delivery from outside off to long leg. Manages a couple
good length on and around the stumps, defended
good length ball on off stump, Yusuf tries to dab it behind point but Faf had read the stroke and raced to his right from slip to flick the ball back to the keeper
a shade short, although it does turn quite sharply. Yadav has moved away from the ball to make room and lifts it over the covers
flighted outside off, defended into the leg side
deep midwicket, here you go, says Pandey. Tossed up outside off, lunges forward and sweeps. But it seems more of a top edge than anything. Bravo barely has anything to do
flighted in middle, defended towards point
some turn, of the quick kind. Yadav follows it with an open face, beats the slip fielder as Raina dives to his right. And the outfield's too quick. Well, for Ashwin at least
good length ball on middle and leg, tapped into the midwicket region
tossed up on leg stump, Pandey is forward with a tuck past midwicket
flatter delivery on off stump, pushed through the covers
into the push too early and the ball lobs up. Only it's a few feet to the left of Jadeja. Nice flight, slow pace. Perfet on this pitch
goes back and punches a flatter ball to long-on
turn, appreciable amounts of it, as Ashwin tosses the ball up. That's when the batsman get uncertain and before Pandey could decide on anything the ball rips in and hits the top half of his bat
flighted outside off, presses forward to block
tossed up outside off, steps forward and nudges the ball behind square leg

Baz again! Pulls off a smart catch and turns an ordinary ball into a wicket-taking one. It was short, it could have been belted through the off side, but Uthappa wants to drag it. Finds short midwicket
the edge picks its spot! It's a lovely, fuller delivery angled across the right-hander. Pandey pokes with half a bat and only manages a little nick. Dhoni and Ashwin stop and stare
fullish, and perhaps a shade slower, defended into the covers for a quick single
brilliant strike! Strong stride forward and a pristine straight bat coming down in line with the ball. Lifts it over mid-off and enjoys the sight of it skipping away to the boundary
too full for the swipe through midwicket. Nice, fullish length from Nehra and doesn't offer much room. Inside edge to fine leg
good length ball working the left-armer's angle. Tapped into the covers
fullish and outside off, Pandey slides it to the left of point where Jaddu cuts it short
shortish on middle, nudged to mid-on
short and wide, Manish slaps it at point where McCullum prowls
another shortish delivery, Uthappa comes forward and flat-bats it down the ground. Didn't time this one though
half a scoop, half a pull. Gap found. Mohit perseveres coaxing help out of the middle of the pitch. Nothing there to respond to him
short again and Uthappa plants his front leg down and lifts it over square leg. Easy flick over square leg. No one down there
long hop but Uthappa has stepped forward and mowed it wide of long-on. That's a typically Uthappa stroke. Front foot bash
short and outside off, rears up more than Manish Pandey expects, he shaped to play a flamboyant stroke but ultimately lets the ball through to the keeper
full and just outside off, squeezed towards midwicket, the ball trickles outside the circle, Uthappa was keen on two, ran the first one with intent, but there wasn't time to return
full and down the leg side, Uthappa should have put that away past short fine leg for four, but he can't get bat on it, still a wide though
overpitched and on the pads, a lofted drive wide of mid-on sends the ball racing away for four, Uthappa is in a hurry though this is a small target
driven towards mid-on this time, too firmly to have time to take a single
timing! Uthappa gets a non-violent six, it was pitched-up and on the pads, nonchalantly clipped over midwicket, and astonishingly it carries all the way
drops this a touch short, not the most elegant shot from Pandey, who looked to clobber that from outside off, gets it towards backward square leg
length ball outside off, squeezed towards backward point, no run there
back of a length ball sits up for Uthappa, who swivels and pulls that in front of square leg for four
towards third man for one more this time
Brendon McCullum makes a diving stop at sweeper cover, saves a run for his side
back of a length and angling across, jabbed off the front foot through covers
pitched up, bit of movement inwards, pushed off the front foot to the right of the bowler
gets back in the crease and defends towards the leg side
a touch shorter but similarly wide, Pandey is content to leave this one through to the keeper
full and well outside off, that is cracked stylishly through cover for four by Manish Pandey
some calm after the drama off the first two deliveries, left alone outside off

well, well, this is quite the eventful start, Gamhir gone second ball to an age-old failing, fishes outside off to a back of a length ball, no footwork, nibbles it through to the keeper, the Chennai crowd goes wild, cries of 'CSK CSK' ring around the ground

there's a direct hit first ball from McCullum. whoah, McCullum just slapped that back from cover, didn't catch the ball since he didn't have the time, just an open-palm forehand back on to the stumps, Gambhir's in though after responding early to Uthappa's call
